_meta.note: Seeded by CatalogSeeder. Adding a category here creates it; it never deletes one, because a category with products in it is not something a data file should be able to remove. Use the admin panel's on/off switch to hide a category instead — that hides its products too, reversibly.
_meta.active: The launch set is food-only: imported-food-grocery, dates, honey, beverage, dry-fruits, spices, nuts-makhana, baby-food, herbs, oil-ghee. Everything else is "active": false — kept in full (slug, blurb, children, seeder row) so switching it back on is one boolean, not a re-authoring job. This flag is the static-site mirror of the DB's is_active column: the front end reads it in modules/catalog/backend/api.js getCategories() and shared/js/components/category-menu.js, and tools/sitemap.py skips inactive slugs. Turning one back on: flip it here, then re-run tools/assemble.py and tools/sitemap.py, and add it back to the hand-authored lists in shared/components/header.html + index.html.
